sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment inspection I3, which must be performed 
on an annually bases as indicated by 
Y1 in the title block.

The burner fuel oil boosters 
pumps (3 per unit) have capacity of 908 L/mint at a discharge pressure of 83 Kg/Cm2 and 115C each
under normal operation two pumps are in service the discharge pressure of the 
pump
is controlled by pressure control valve that recirculates
the oil back to the suction of the burner fuel oil heaters

The first draft initiated by eng.
Ali El-Safoury, tested by eng. Mohamed Anwar Ghazy, accepted by general director 
eng. Gamal Abd El-Meguid El-Safoury, and approved by eng. Mohamed El-Tahawy: head sector of Shoubra El-Khimah PS.

تم تنقيح هذه الوثيقة بواسطة المهندس. Nageh Soliman Shousha: 
 CEPC quality control director, and certified by eng. Afaf Ebrahim 
 El-Dib: CEPC inspection & quality control's Head Sector and MPIS coordinator.
احتياطات السلامة

Work order must be issued and the
maintenance staff should the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear the safety and healthy equipment as safety 
helmet, shoes, earplugs etc.

Isolate the circuit breaker of 
the fan motor.

Disconnect electric terminals 
of fan motor.

The fan must be isolated 
mechanically by closing delivery damper.

Contact 
 thermometer.

Standard set of 
 tools.

Dial gauge 
 indicator clamp feeler.

Oil Mobil DTE 
 heavy.
العمل المراد تنفيذه

Check bearing temperature 
and change oil if needed or check the bearing (repair or change)

Check for excessive vibration 
and repair the cause of vibration by checking the internal parts of pump (repair 
or change) or check the motor and repair it.
Listen for unusual noise

Check mech. seal for leakage 
and change if needed.

Prior to stopping pump check bearing temperature and measure vibration change 
oil (Max Vib. = 48 mm/sec)

Check clearance and alignment between two
shafts and readjust the clearance again.

Check the P/P for capacity and discharge
press. or check the parts of the pump and change the defected parts.
